Each delay component must have a documented non-overlapping meaning. A response with unknown terms is not usable. first_send/original_ttl are immutable across retries. ACK accepted/applied are insufficient: current session, matching request_type/seq, valid capture, faults and current profile are also required by authority. A deadline at or before now grants no motion.

PC_DIRECT uses min(host_issue_ns + bounded_duration_ns, sample_lo + age_cap, previous_deadline if present). It still requires actual FPGA observations for the formal chain; there is no fictional board motion ACK/capture. STOP requires no fresh observation. A heartbeat never extends any command or observation deadline.

host_contract.json is a strict whitelist for transport envelopes, with additionalProperties=false at every object boundary. Runtime validation additionally enforces the cross-field rules in this document and enums.json. JSON validation alone does not prove process/ACL isolation, model usefulness, calibrated sensing or either complete control chain.

world_authority alone issues motion grants and integrates physics. ai_controller supplies candidates; hardware_bridge supplies received framed observations/capture facts. No controller pipe admits obstacle identifiers, layout/seed/editor history, exact collision queries, future sensor values, screen access or a hidden-map route. Public task geometry contains only cube/drill, chosen gates and uncertain initial odometry. Both HIL and PC_DIRECT remain required.

The bridge-to-authority `board_response` envelope transports the exact bounded ABI3 STATE (0x08, 32 bytes), CONFIG_ACK, GAIN_ACK, BOOT_ACK, ACK3D or STATE3D bytes and receipt interval, plus nullable measurement-record SHA256 references. It is not available to ai_controller and never itself authorizes motion. Authority reparses CRC/type/length/session/epoch and binds the original request and capture history. BOOT_ACK uses the proposed stopped-state context until exact handshake verification succeeds. Nullable measurement references are explicit unknowns; nonnull hashes still require independently authenticated records.

STATE 0x08 carries physical GAIN or PC_DIRECT clock/health diagnostics using the frozen 18-byte payload. Its capture-shaped fields never authorize three-axis movement. PC_DIRECT STATE requires a null physical motion-capture reference. Fault/phase changes are delivered to authority, which stops when required; STATE never creates an observation, changes its acquisition time, or renews any command deadline. A missing heartbeat remains a separate runtime stop gate; structural parsing is not proof that a live board is present.
|STATE 0x08|32B|物理GAIN或PC_DIRECT心跳；session/phase/TTL/fault等沿用冻结18B结构，不声称PC动作来自板输出|
|GAIN 0x0a / GAIN_ACK 0x0b|24B / 32B|物理量程结构不变，gain_code有限档；回读actual ratio/quality及当前TTL，不能占用同窗3D运动槽|

GAIN/GAIN_ACK和STATE的每字段长度沿用v3修订1，R03须在interface.json展开，独立向量比对，不能只凭总长度声称兼容。所有请求唯一键为(session,request_type,header.seq)，CONTROL3D.cmd_id必须等于header.seq。同键同负载只缓存事务结果与首次应用时刻，每次应答重新取当前phase/capture/fault/remaining_ttl、发送tick和CRC；同键不同负载拒绝。重复不重新应用或续期；被更新命令覆盖的旧请求回superseded/rejected；过期回stopped。旧会话拒绝，seq/epoch回绕前停止换新会话。

CONFIG在块边界原子生效，CONFIG_ACK给实际profile/E/rate/threshold、applied_epoch及首个生效采样序号；采样低16位只能在小于半周期关联范围内比较。phase为accepted/applied/captured/rejected/stopped，由interface.json冻结数值；accepted或写寄存器不等于电气执行。BOOT的slot_profile_sha128为完整规范SHA256前16B，覆盖ABI、topology、线速、所有槽/重试偏移、响应时限、通道单位、速度映射、TTL和运动学约束；完整SHA在host证据保存，不仅哈希一张槽表。不一致不得ENABLE，切模式必须停止、新session和BOOT回读。

CONTROL3D中yaw_q和pitch_q均为有符号int16、0.001°/s每码，各±15000；speed_code0–20。FAST_9600每码0.0125m/s、最高0.25m/s、TTL≤3000ms；STRESS_300每码0.0001m/s、最高0.002m/s、TTL≤12000ms。两个映射不得混用，profile匹配先于执行。PC、PL和world均校验量化后的合成曲率与profile。码值表示在本命令目标速度v_target处的角速度参考；v_target>0时κcmd=(yaw_q,pitch_q)×π/(180000×v_target)，要求其范数≤0.5/m；v_target=0须两角速码=0。PL按profile/speed_code ROM的保守整数阈值判yaw_q²+pitch_q²≤floor((v_target×180000/(2π))²)，64bit中间量，越界拒绝而非偷偷clip。执行器保持κcmd，按加速度界更新v_actual，每物理步ω_actual=v_actual×κcmd；减速直至0时角速度同时归0，禁止原地转向，换命令同样先校验。三路电气捕获证明目标参考/速度码，实际运动学另留轨迹，不能把目标码当瞬时实际角速。完整障碍几何只在合法信念图及world各自边界内检查，PL不读取隐藏障碍。

HIL三路yaw/pitch/speed GPIO/PWM均经真实物理短线回到独立捕获逻辑。两角速参考的30001个合法码候选以20ms周期、100MHz计数时钟、high_ticks=10000+16×(q+15000)表示，高电平0.1–4.9ms；speed high_ticks=50000+1000×speed_code，即0.5–0.7ms，周期相同。R03/G05须证明实际IO稳定、捕获计数、码型/定时容差并写入BOOT规范；周期/高电平不匹配则capture无效，不把粗舵机PWM冒充此精度。独立捕获按最近合法高电平计数解码，角速捕获候选容差≤2tick，严格小于半码8tick，实测成立才允许ENABLE；若实物抖动不能满足必须优化电气编码并重冻结ABI规范，不放宽曲率或伪造量化精度。ACK3D/STATE3D的34B在线短帧只返回表内解码yaw/pitch/speed、capture_seq/control_epoch/quality，不能免费附加三路原始period/count；原始周期、计数和边沿tick留PL寄存器与本地取证，不进入AI旁路。不能只回读写寄存器伪称真实IO捕获。断任一路即capture无效，运动停止。A在R02选实际可用且不冲突的引脚/电平；PGA量程另走GAIN，measured_ratio来自调节前后ADC标定读数，不伪造MCP6S21不存在的SO读回。HIL电气因果、PC_DIRECT host命令因果和真实PGA物理响应三类证据分报。

TTL从PL首次应用起计；ACK/STATE头tick为首字节发送时刻，remaining_ttl为该次当前值。TELEM.tick_ms为最后纳入摘要的样本采样tick，不能以发送tick冒充新样本；摘要跨度在profile固定。host保存first_send_monotonic与original_ttl，重试不重置；截止=min(first_send+original_ttl, receipt+max(0,current_remaining_ttl−frame_serial_time−USB/处理延迟上界−时钟误差界))。每个物理步检查截止、会话和capture；首次ACK丢失、8秒后同键重试且STATE/EVENT持续丢失时，不得在首次成功收到晚ACK后重新给12秒。USB/时钟界无法建立即停止，不以新TELEM/重复ACK复活旧动作。

两种完整导向模式均由PC AI实际参与，FPGA仍承担不可省略的数据入口、压缩和链路。三条路径复用统一MotionCommand内部契约：run_id、session、cmd_seq、observed_seq、source、yaw_rate、pitch_rate、speed、ttl、model_hash和plan_id；wire只传冻结的紧凑字段，其他在host证据关联，不能当免费字节。运动执行只能来自启动时固定的一种拓扑；切换先停机/清租期/新握手，新run不继承上次动作。

HIL沿用v3的首次发送时刻上界、剩余TTL当前重算、幂等不续期及过期不复活；新增俯仰输出与独立回采。PC_DIRECT截止取命令首次发出＋TTL与最后有效采样时刻＋观测年龄限两者的较早值；FAST年龄限1500ms、STRESS12000ms，STATE心跳不刷新旧样本年龄。重放/同seq不续期；顶栏明确PC直控，不能伪装板端输出。硬件调试旁路、UI按钮、world碰撞oracle均无权替AI补路线。

The main-selected plan is ../next-software-main-20261020/hil-request-design-plan.md. This is a diagnostic association component, not a sender, authority, measurement authenticator or HIL executor. Three assigned new product paths only; mailbox is read-only and never imported.

`HilRequestTracker(run_id, dependencies=None)` is owned by its constructing thread. `HilDependencies` supplies explicit `verify_boot(event)`, `verify_observation(raw, boot)`, `verify_timing(raw, boot, original_request)` and `verify_capture(raw, boot, original_request)` methods. No permissive provider exists. Frozen result dataclasses retain exact original BOOT/request/raw associations; they are not credentials. Source/clock/capture authenticity and nonoverlapping measured delay meanings remain upstream obligations. None is unknown and cannot qualify an association.

`boot(event, now_ns=...)` replaces the previous activation with STOP before calling the verifier. A returned strict same-run BootBinding carries immutable existing sealed context, increasing generation and an original source identity (None remains unknown). Only topology1 HIL is accepted; PC_DIRECT is refused, never recast as capture. At most64 used/proposed sessions are remembered, with refusal on exhaustion. A structurally valid verified proposal is retired before the final veto fence, so caught STOP/reentry cannot make it reusable. New BOOT resets per-session request/observation/response high waters, not the used-session/generation history or host clock high-water.

`observe(raw, now_ns=...)` validates CRC/schema/active context and the verifier's exact original source association/sample lower bound; at most four same-activation TELEM/EVENT references are retained. Unknown source/mapping does not admit an observation. Receipt/completion time never replaces sample acquisition. Same raw duplicate does not renew; conflict, backward/half-range/wrap requires STOP/fresh session.

`request(packet, first_send_ns=..., now_ns=...)` accepts only wire CONTROL3D14, CONFIG5 and GAIN10. Non-motion types retain identity/bytes only and cannot qualify. BOOT wire exchange belongs to verify_boot and is not admitted here. CONTROL3D parses the existing16-byte payload, session/cmd_id/header.seq/config epoch, STOP zero-field rule, bounded TTL, speed and quantized curvature. The immutable OriginalRequest stores `(session,type,seq)`, first raw packet, semantic payload, first-send, original TTL, original observation reference/sample and target codes. Entry separately stores only the latest received raw retry. Same payload may have a different tick/CRC but retains original time/deadline; changed payload rejects. History is16 entries; three per-type nonwrapping sequence high waters protect eviction. Different request types have different keys. Superseding CONTROL3D retires the old command. STOP latches the activation; expiry/eviction permanently retires that request, while a new command may use new valid evidence.

`response(raw_board_response, now_ns=...)` uses existing host validator before callbacks/state mutation. ACK3D must bind type14/request_seq; STATE3D must bind last_control_seq/current request. Other board responses, including STATE8, are diagnostics only. Captured phase3, fault0, quality15, exact target codes, current independent capture/BOOT/request/batch and strict timing evidence are required. The existing validator already requires response control_epoch==active context.config_epoch: preserve that strict frozen rule rather than invent a second domain. A changed/wrapped epoch needs a new verified session. Capture sequence is nondecreasing without wrap. Changed duplicate response identities and backward/half-range sender sequence fail closed; an exact wire repeat cannot renew, even with a new receipt envelope.

Deadline is exactly min(original first-send+TTL, receipt.lower+max(0,current remainingTTL−serialUpper−usbProcessingUpper−clockErrorUpper), original sample lower+FAST1500ms/STRESS12000ms, previous deadline). Receipt.lower is conservative. Equality to now expires. No new observation/retry/ACK/STATE can increase a request deadline or resurrect retired requests. Unknown original observation remains unknown even if a later observation arrives. `check(now_ns=...)` returns the current frozen Association diagnostic; `snapshot()` is detached bounded state. A qualified association is still not send/motion permission.

All time-taking methods use strict nonregressing host integers. Public wrappers catch malformed call shapes before a trusted callback can catch them without recording a veto. Reentry invalidates the in-flight transition. STOP is always permitted and changes veto generation; verifiers are fenced immediately on return and before publication. Exceptions fail closed. Foreign-thread calls set a pending STOP for the owner and reject; providers may not do asynchronous/reentrant admission. A malicious trusted verifier hiding internal failure or fabricating original evidence is outside the valid provider contract, not made trustworthy by dataclass type/hash/boolean.

TDD: independent binascii CRC packet builders and hand-derived JSON event deadlines; actual initial RED, minimal implementation, targeted GREEN and retained failures. No full245 run, no existing source/schema/BOOT/gate edits, Git index/commit, native runtime, network, UI, board or service action. All29/R03/G05/full H12 remain not_run.
